done: Look at you, a real local now!|If you ever get lost, /spawn will bring you right back here.

npcs.name: &3Archivist Wren
idle: The boards update every minute.|Who will top them this month?
Catch Pokémon and beat trainers to climb the boards.
done: Your name could be up there one day.|Keep training!

npcs.name: &cEV Coach Tess

npcs.name: &9Referee Kai

npcs.name: &eCaptain Marlo

done: How's that Lapras treating you?|Fair winds, trainer!

npcs.name: &aProfessor Cedar
idle: Welcome to my lab! I study how Pokémon and people live together on this island.|Every entry you add to your Pokédex helps my research.

done: My favourite field researcher!|How is your Pokédex coming along?

npcs.name: &6Librarian Paige

done: Back for more reading?|The shelves on the left are my favourites.

npcs.name: &3Curator Hale
idle: Welcome to the Oceanic Museum.|Every exhibit here was found in the waters around our island.

done: Ah, our seasoned traveller returns.|Have you found anything worth an exhibit out there?

steps.where: at the info pavilion, north-west of the plaza
lines: Oh! A new face! Welcome to Port Azure, {player}!
> Thanks! Where am I?
You're on our little island town in the middle of the sea.
I'm Mae, the town guide. I help new trainers find their feet.
The best way to learn the town is to meet everyone who runs it.
Start with Nurse Joy at the Pokémon Center. It's the big building with the red roof, at the north end of the Grand Avenue.
Oh, and one more thing...
Once you've met everyone, find Captain Marlo down at the ferry pier. He has a surprise for you!

steps.where: inside the Pokémon Center (red roof, at the north end of the Grand Avenue)
lines: Hello, and welcome to the Pokémon Center!
> Mae sent me. I'm new in town!
How wonderful! We heal Pokémon here, free of charge, any time you need.
You'll find the GTS and Wonder Trade machines along the east wall, for trading with other trainers.
And please do read the server rules on the board in the plaza.
Next, you should meet Ollie at the department store. It's the big building with the blue band, west of the plaza.

steps.where: inside the department store (blue band, west of the plaza)
lines: Welcome to the department store! What can I get you?
> Just looking around. Nurse Joy sent me.
Ah, a newcomer! Let me tell you how things work.
Type /shop to see everything we sell: Poké Balls, healing, keys, titles, all sorts.
And if your bag's getting heavy, /sell opens a box you can drop everything into.
Rin runs the Crate Pavilion, north-east of the plaza. Go and try your luck!

steps.where: at the Crate Pavilion (north-east of the plaza)
lines: Step right up! Feeling lucky?
> What are these crates?
Each one holds prizes. Master Balls, shiny Pokémon, even legendaries!
Left-click any crate to see every reward and its exact chance.
Hold the matching key and right-click to open it.
Keys come from chores, quests, loot balls and the shop.
Wren keeps the Hall of Champions, on the north side of the plaza. Go see who's on top!

steps.where: at the Hall of Champions (north side of the plaza)
lines: Ah, a visitor to the Hall of Champions.
> What are all these boards?
These boards track the town's greatest trainers.
Most Pokémon caught, most trainers beaten, and the richest trainers of all time.
The first two reset every month, so anyone can make it up here.
The world map hangs in the Warp Station, east of the plaza, if you want to pin your base.
Tess trains Pokémon at the EV Training Center on North Row. Look for the orange band. She can make your team stronger.

steps.where: inside the EV Training Center (orange band, on North Row)
lines: Ready to get stronger?
> Wren said you could help me train.
She's right! Do you know about EVs?
Every Pokémon you defeat gives your team a little training in one stat.
Each of the six stations in here trains a different stat.
Pair it with a Power item and you'll train twice as fast.
Kai referees battles at the Tournament Arena, in the north-east corner of the island. Go and say hi!

steps.where: at the Tournament Arena (north-east corner of the island)
lines: Halt! Who goes there?
> I'm {player}. I'm new in town.
Ha! Just kidding. Welcome!
This is the Tournament Arena, where trainers settle their battles.
Challenge a friend any time. Battle fair, and shake hands after.
I think you've met just about everyone now.
Except one. Head down to the harbour and find Captain Marlo at the ferry pier.

steps.where: at the ferry pier, by the S.S. Seabreeze (south harbour)
lines: Ahoy there! You must be the newcomer everyone's talking about.
> Mae said you had a surprise for me?
Ha! That I do. But first, let me look at you...
You've met the whole town. That's the mark of a real Port Azure local.
There's a friend of mine who's been waiting a long time for a trainer worth sailing with.
I think that trainer is you.
after: Her name's up to you, but she's yours now.
Her riding stats are maxed out, so she'll carry you across any sea.
Fair winds, {player}. Come visit the old captain sometime!

reward.message: Captain Marlo gave you a Lapras with maxed riding stats, and 2,500 CobbleDollars!

jobs.name: Ticket to the Frontier
jobs.description: Earn your passage to the Battle Frontier.

steps.where: at the ferry pier, by the S.S. Seabreeze
lines: Ahoy, {player}! Settling in all right?
> I keep hearing about a place called the Battle Frontier.
Ha! Every trainer does, sooner or later.
The Seabreeze sails there, but only stamped tickets go up the gangway. Captain's rules.
Here's a blank one. Three boxes, three stamps.
Referee Kai, Nurse Joy and Curator Hale. Earn all three, then bring it back to me.

steps.where: at the Tournament Arena (north-east corner of the island)
steps.task: Win a battle against a trainer or another player
notyet: A Frontier ticket? Blank as the day it was printed!
> Marlo said you could stamp it.
Only once you've earned it. Win a battle against a trainer or another player, then come back to me.
Wild Pokémon don't count. I want to see you outbattle someone!
lines: There it is! You battled like a real competitor.
> So you'll stamp it?
One stamp, right there. Wear it proudly.
Nurse Joy will want to check your team before a long voyage. Go and see her.
Oh my, a voyage to the Battle Frontier?
> Kai said you'd check my team first.
Of course! Let me take a look...
Happy, healthy and ready for anything. I'll heal them up for the trip all the same.
There's your second stamp. Curator Hale at the Oceanic Museum has the last one.

steps.where: inside the Oceanic Museum (north-west corner of the island)
steps.task: Find the Battle Frontier exhibit in the museum
notyet: The Battle Frontier? Now there's a story.
> I need your stamp for my ticket.
Not so fast! A traveller should know where they're going.
Find the Battle Frontier exhibit here in the museum and read it. Then come back to me.
lines: So, you found the exhibit. What did you make of it?
> An island where the battles never stop?
Built by trainers who wanted to face the very best. Few have ever reached the end.
Here's your final stamp. Captain Marlo will be waiting at the pier.

steps.where: at the ferry pier, by the S.S. Seabreeze
lines: Three stamps! Kai, Joy and Hale. You did it, {player}.
> So I can come aboard?
Hand it over... There. The ticket's mine now, and your cabin's ready.
All aboard the S.S. Seabreeze! Next stop: the Battle Frontier!

reward.message: From now on, /warp frontier takes you straight to the Battle Frontier.
